name: Gene Oakland

tenures.role: authority figure: president and owner of the ASWA and chief executive of its parent, All Star Wrestling, who announced the Midwest Wrestling Express at a press conference in Milwaukee
tenures.note: April 2001: "Oakland, the owner of All Star Wrestling Inc. has announced that the next phase of ASW's development will be the creation of a federation in the Midwest"; "Oakland held a press conference earlier today in Milwaukee, Wisconsin". The ASWA's handbook of December 2000 (promotions/aswa-utah-2000/archive/aswa-utah-faq-and-application-2000-12-14.html) names him President and Owner and the chief executive of All Star Wrestling.

caption: President and owner of the All Star Wrestling Alliance and chief executive of its parent company, All Star Wrestling, a former wrestler whose career a mistimed powerbomb ended; in April 2001 he announced a second federation, the Midwest Wrestling Express, at a press conference in Milwaukee.

identity.note: Shares the name of the APW announcer of 1997 (newsgroup pages); this is the ASWA's owner and the chief executive of All Star Wrestling, 2000 to 2001. No document ties the two.
